title: Turning — Why did they turn you?

rows.label: They wanted a companion in undeath and asked you.
You were dying, or sick, and it was the only way to keep you alive.
They almost drained you, and in an act of desperation, turned you.
They did it to make you suffer or to punish you for something.
You never knew. They disappeared without a trace right after you were turned.
They wanted to ensure some kind of legacy and saw you as an excellent candidate, and you wanted to be more like them.
They wanted access to your useful skills and assets, and you were convinced or coerced by them.
They believed you’d have a better existence in undeath, and proposed turning you.
